items.title: Business representatives discover opportunities in Linyi
items.description: Business delegates from Nigeria, Ghana and Australia shared their insights into the city's markets and business environment at the fourth Linyi Trade City International Sourcing Conference, which is running from Oct 28 to 30 in Linyi, Shandong province.

items.title: Strengthening the Party
items.description: A key meeting of the Communist Party of China adopted a resolution on persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance, highlighting that the significance of strengthening the Party must be understood from the strategic height of consolidating the Party's long-term governance and realizing national rejuvenation.

items.title: Tackle the root causes of corruption
items.description: The 20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) held its fifth plenary session from Monday to Thursday in Beijing, adopting the Resolution of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Certain Major Issues concerning Persevering with Full and Rigorous Party Self-Governance.

items.title: Multinationals gear up for ninth edition of CIIE
items.description: In an acknowledgment of the role played by the China International Import Expo in introducing global innovations to China and deepening cooperation with various partners, a number of multinational companies that have participated in every past edition of the event are ready to attend once again.

items.title: Health focus vital to China's poverty plan
items.description: China's efforts to integrate health into its national poverty alleviation strategy offer important lessons for tackling extreme poverty worldwide, highlighting the need to prioritize health, coordinate government action and expand primary healthcare coverage, according to a report released on Thursday by the Lancet Commission.

items.title: AI models for extreme weather forecasts built
items.description: China has unveiled two artificial intelligence models for extreme weather forecasting, using data from its Fengyun meteorological satellites to move beyond monitoring current conditions and predict how weather systems will evolve.

items.title: China slams Japan's remilitarization bid
items.description: Japan's expanding military deployments and efforts to strengthen military cooperation with other countries show that it is accelerating its remilitarization, posing a threat to regional security, a Chinese defense spokesman said on Thursday.

items.title: First look: 2026 WIC Wuzhen Summit
items.description: The 2026 World Internet Conference Wuzhen Summit will take place from Nov 2 to 5 in Wuzhen, East China's Zhejiang province. What will happen when modern technology meets China's ancient town? The summit will gather executives from leading technology companies and developers of open-source large models to discuss how to build a global open-source AI ecosystem. Watch the video to find out!
